yara: Heads up — onboarding the PHP sample app hit a weird parity issue. The UI uses streaming chat + function-calling to render a live assistant, curl+REST works, but the php sdk returns the full response and function_call support seems missing.

oleg: which endpoint + params?

yara: REST that works:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -d '{"model":"chat-3","messages":[],"stream":true,"function_calls":"auto"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat
```
This yields SSE events including function_call deltas. Using the php client: `$client->chat->create(["model"=>"chat-3","messages"=>[],"stream"=>true,"function_calls"=>"auto"]);` resolves to a single final object, and `function_calls` isn't present on the request if I introspect.

marta: hmm we've had a case where PHP generator maps boolean flags differently. Any errors in logs?

yara: two things: 1) the php SDK stringifies booleans for form encoding so `stream` becomes "1" or "0" which our event-path checks treat as false. 2) function_calls param is not in the generated binding (OpenAPI had `x-feature:function_calls`, generator ignored vendor extension).

dev-rel-bot: filed DEVEX-php-498: php-sdk boolean/stringify + missing function_calls. https://git.redwood/dev/php-sdk/issues/498 :white_check_mark:

oleg: also saw your other note about signature failures in on-prem. Can you paste the failing curl vs SDK headers?

yara: sure. curl headers: `Authorization: Bearer X`, `X-Request-Timestamp: 1680000000`, `Content-Type: application/json`. Works. PHP SDK sends `authorization: Bearer X` (lowercased) and uses json_encode on associative arrays which can reorder keys -> our HMAC signer on some proxies computes signature over canonical JSON ordering and rejects the sdk request with 401.

marta: ugh. So three separate parity issues: boolean/stringification, missing function_calls binding, and canonicalization/header-casing differences causing signature mismatches. Together these made onboarding hang (no streaming, then 401s).

ci-bot: labels added: sdk/php, bug, onboarding, streaming, headers, signing. Assigned to @oleg.

oleg: plan: 1) quick patch to generator to include vendor extension for function_calls and expose it in the PHP binding; 2) change PHP transport to preserve header case as provided and expose an option `preserve_header_case` default true for on-prem customers; 3) ensure json encoding for signed requests uses a deterministic canonical JSON routine for signing (but send original body as provided to preserve compatibility); 4) stop coercing booleans to strings for JSON payloads — keep native JSON booleans. Also add an integration test: streaming + function_calls + HMAC signing against staging proxy.

yara: short-term workaround I used: call REST directly with Guzzle, build canonical JSON, set `Accept: text/event-stream` and `Authorization` exactly. It unblocked the demo. I'll add the snippet to the php sample README.

oleg: ETA: branch up today, patch release targeted tomorrow if CI passes. I'll post the PR and link to the test run here.

yara: amazing — thanks for the speedy triage. This was blocking a customer demo :pray:
